# Rename a file to a new path or replace an existing file.
cp first.txt renamed.txt
mv renamed.txt new.txt
! exists renamed.txt
cmp new.txt first.txt
cp second.txt replaced.txt
mv new.txt replaced.txt
! exists new.txt
cmp replaced.txt first.txt

# Move a single file into an existing directory, keeping its basename.
mkdir dst
mv replaced.txt dst
! exists replaced.txt
cmp dst/replaced.txt first.txt

# Move multiple files from nested paths into the same directory.
mkdir src
cp first.txt src/first.txt
cp second.txt src/second.txt
mv src/first.txt src/second.txt dst
! exists src/first.txt src/second.txt
cmp dst/first.txt first.txt
cmp dst/second.txt second.txt

# Resolve both sources and destinations relative to the script directory.
cd dst
mv first.txt second.txt ../src
! exists first.txt second.txt
cmp ../src/first.txt ../first.txt
cmp ../src/second.txt ../second.txt

# Directories can still be renamed, or moved into an existing directory.
cd ..
mv src renamed
! exists src
cmp renamed/first.txt first.txt
mv renamed dst
! exists renamed
cmp dst/renamed/first.txt first.txt
cmp dst/renamed/second.txt second.txt

-- first.txt --
first file
-- second.txt --
second file
